items.statement: The submitted quantitative profile supports the proposed radical carbonylation sequence within the stated computational boundary.
items.expected: The conclusion connects validated stationary points and relative free energies to CO capture, iodine transfer, and amine attack, while distinguishing computational support from proof of the full photochemical cycle.

items.statement: Amine selectivity is interpreted from both kinetics and thermodynamics.
items.expected: Morpholine is identified as favored within the modeled comparison because its attack is comparatively accessible and its tetrahedral intermediate is thermodynamically favorable, whereas aromatic amines have positive intermediate free energies; limitations are stated.
